sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: With majkinetor's String Theory 2026.11.20.165956 or newer, a table of ours now asks Event Horizon to leave all its keys alone except its on/off switch, through the shared marks <html data-mbu-keys-off="saed" data-mbu-keys-keep="toggle"> (#938 convention C3, keys-keep added by majkinetor 2026-11-20). Its newer keys stay off the table too: U (your profile, which left the page), Ctrl+P (its player, so the browser prints again) and its player's Space, arrows and Alt+1/2/3. A toggle rebound in Event Horizon to a letter keeps working. The marks come down while Event Horizon's view shows, and are never set over another script's (_mbuKeysSync(), _ehKeysKeepHonoured()).

Before a button is pressed, and with a standalone or older Event Horizon, the single-letter guard stays as it was, now with U. The setting is renamed "Keep Event Horizon's keys off MusicBrainz's page" (sa_block_eh_single_keys, same key and default).

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: The shared MusicBrainz request gate (mbu:mb-gate): every write of this script now lowers a broken hold or lead in the stored schedule, a cool past now + 60 s to now + 60 s and a leadUntil past now + 10 s to now + 10 s, as majkinetor's scripts do since a1e8f54 (#938, 2026-11-20). A value ten minutes out is then repaired for every tab and script after the write, not only counted capped by this tab (9.99.1651). A tab that already counts such a value keeps the end it gave it at first sight, so its own write does not restart the minute (_mbGateClampWrite(), in _mbGateState()).
